$comment: Reviewed differences between the hugo-theme-stack build and the Runbook build of
the reference archive (citizix.com). Consumed by scripts/check_parity.py.
EVERY RULE NEEDS A NON-EMPTY `reason` AND THE SCRIPT ENFORCES THAT.  An
unexplained allow-rule is indistinguishable from someone silencing a real
regression; six months later nobody can tell which it was.  Same rule, same
A rule marked `defect: true` is NOT a design decision.  It is a known bug that is
allowed only so the gate keeps reporting the other 100 differences instead of
failing on the same two lines forever.  Delete the rule when the bug is fixed —
check_parity.py prints every reason on every run, so it stays visible.
Measured 2026-07-28 against citizix@dc1b321 with Hugo v0.164.0+extended.
Full analysis and per-difference reasoning: docs/migration.md.

rules.reason: Runbook's /tags/ and /categories/ BROWSE pages are unpaginated by design (specs/003 §3.4): every term, grouped by initial letter and counted, on one page. Stack paginates them at pagerSize, which on this archive minted /tags/page/2..30/ and /categories/page/2..3/. Those 31 URLs disappear. They are indexed today, so the site must ship 301s (see docs/migration.md §4) — this rule records that the LOSS is intended, not that the redirects are optional.
Hugo mints /page/1/ as a meta-refresh alias to the unpaginated first page. No pagination on the taxonomy browse page means no page/1 to alias. Same root cause as the url rule above.
Consequence of the pages themselves no longer existing, not an independent canonical change. No page that still exists changed its canonical.
Consequence of the pages themselves no longer existing. No page that still exists changed its og:url.

specs/003 §3.7 item 4 — page kinds map to schema types EXPLICITLY. citizix's schema.html emits @type Article for every .IsPage, so a privacy policy and a search page both claimed to be news articles with a mainEntityOfPage. Runbook types them WebPage, which has no mainEntityOfPage. This is a correction; the four URLs are unchanged and still carry BreadcrumbList.

These are <image:loc> values, not page URLs — citizix overrides layouts/sitemap.xml with a Google image-sitemap extension. It fires on `.Params.image`, which exactly two pages in a 1,154-page build carry, and on one of those it emits an empty <image:title/> because `$.Title` inside `range .Data.Pages` resolves to the sitemap page. Runbook uses Hugo's internal sitemap. See docs/migration.md §5 for why the override is classified citizix-only and recommended for deletion rather than porting.

DEFECT (templates/SEO stream): layouts/rss.xml uses `site.RegularPages` for the home feed instead of filtering to `params.mainSections`, so /about-us/, /contact-us/, /privacy-policy/ and /search/ are published as feed items. Stack's feed carries 490 posts; Runbook's carries 494 pages. Delete this rule when rss.xml filters by mainSections.

DEFECT (templates/SEO stream): layouts/rss.xml ranges `.RegularPages`, which is EMPTY on a taxonomy list kind — a term is not a regular page. /tags/index.xml drops from 295 items to 0 and /categories/index.xml from 28 to 0, so both feeds ship as valid-but-empty channels. Fix is either `.Pages` for taxonomy kinds or not emitting RSS for them at all. Delete this rule when it is fixed.
